title: LawOfTheWorld
description: Law Of The World — a mod for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 that lets you control the very laws of the world directly in-game 🌍
body:
🌍 **LawOfTheWorld** — Create Your Own Laws in Minecraft!

What does the project add?
LawOfTheWorld is a powerful mod that gives you full control over the fundamental laws of Minecraft. You can change the rules of the game however you want — from calm and comfortable survival to complete chaos.

Now you decide how your world works. The mod provides tools for deep customization of physics, balance, and the behavior of almost everything around you. The world no longer dictates the conditions to you — it adapts to your playstyle.

What features does it have?
The mod offers a wide range of options for changing gameplay mechanics.

**Here’s what you can customize:**

- 🌌 World Physics — full gravity adjustment
 
- ⏳ Day and Night Cycle Speed — speed up or slow down the day/night cycle
 
- 🌱 Plant Growth — control how fast crops and trees grow
 
- 🧍 Player Attributes — health, movement speed, jump height, and other character parameters
 
- ⚔️ Combat and Survival Mechanics — damage, defense, hunger, regeneration, luck, and resource drop amounts
 
- ✈️ Flight and Immortality — enable these abilities for the player
 
- 🐺 Mob Behavior and Stats — health, damage, aggression, and the ability to turn passive mobs into aggressive ones
 
- ⛏️ Loot and Ore Amounts — adjust the frequency and volume of dropped resources
 
- 🎲 Random Events System — add unpredictability to your world
 
- 🔄 Automatic World Law Changes — rules can change over time on their own (if you want them to)
 
Additionally, the mod supports singleplayer and multiplayer, has a convenient configuration interface, and is fully translated into Russian and English.

Why should the user download it?
LawOfTheWorld is worth downloading for anyone who is tired of standard Minecraft and wants a truly personal game.

**With this mod you can:**

- Create a unique survival experience tailored to you (ultra-hardcore or extremely comfortable gameplay).
 
- Set special rules for your server to play with friends according to interesting laws.
 
- Experiment with physics, balance, and world behavior for exciting streams and videos.
 
- Constantly change the rules so that every new playthrough feels fresh and different from the previous one.

Want a world with low gravity where everything floats? Want mobs to be much more dangerous, or the world to be almost peaceful? Want very fast resource growth or extreme rarity? LawOfTheWorld allows you to implement almost any idea.

This is a mod for those who want to be not just a player, but a true creator of their own Minecraft.
